metadata.explanation: Install Boc on the stock stereodefined amino alcohol using di-tert-butyl dicarbonate. The bond construction is chemically standard and passes structure, inventory, leakage, and class-compatibility checks, but the validator found no exact dataset or trusted-template support, so confidence is moderated.
Exact hidden-dataset support was found for oxidation of N-Cbz-3-hydroxypyrrolidine to the target ketone. The precursor had no exact stock hit, so this route is explicitly incomplete.

Alternative first cut proposes direct Cbz protection of 3-pyrrolidinone. Atom inventory and reaction-class compatibility passed validation, but no exact dataset reaction or trusted template supported the cut; therefore confidence is low and the route remains incomplete. No precursor is claimed in stock.

N-debenzylation of the exact-stock benzyl-protected piperidine is proposed to reveal the secondary amine while retaining the two assigned stereocentres. This step was not independently supported by a frozen precedent.

Retrosynthetic cleavage of the piperidine N-cyanoacetyl bond gives the secondary amine and cyanoacetyl chloride. Atom inventory and reaction-class compatibility passed validation, but no exact dataset/template support was found; experimental feasibility therefore remains uncertain.

Cyanoacetylation of the piperidine nitrogen is proposed using exact-stock cyanoacetyl chloride. Chemoselectivity over the exocyclic aniline-like amine may require protection or controlled addition; no exact precedent was found.

Late methylation of the exocyclic secondary amine with methyl iodide gives the target tertiary amino substituent. Atom inventory and class compatibility passed validation, but the hidden evidence supplied no exact reaction/template support.
Reductive amination of the spirocyclic ketone with benzylamine furnishes the N-benzyl amine; this exact disconnection has dataset support.
Hydrogenolytic N-debenzylation gives the primary amine; the exact product-forming transformation is supported by dataset precedent JQECYFYCFOSKFU-UHFFFAOYSA-N>>KDAFVGCPLFJMHY-UHFFFAOYSA-N.
Condensation of the stock spirocyclic ketone with hydroxylamine gives the ketoxime. The oxime-formation step is a standard carbonyl condensation, but no exact dataset validation was obtained here.
Reduction of the corresponding ketoxime to the primary amine is supported by exact dataset precedent MGUVQIFYKYWSGP-UHFFFAOYSA-N>>KDAFVGCPLFJMHY-UHFFFAOYSA-N.
